Mrs. Fisher: It seems like you did good this time.
You: You think? I feel less awful than usual.
Mrs. Fisher: Improvement is a good sign. Keep up the good work and these sessions will become unnecessary.
You: How many are left?
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Normal+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: No idea, how the hell am I supposed to know? I’m not some shaman. 
You: Then why are you giving me these to smoke? {{wi}}You know what, never mind that. I’m going home.
It’s just useless to ask her any questions. It’s all just vibes and prayers with her.
